topic: Bruno breaks a flower pot while playing and learns to say sorry and help fix it.

episode.title: Mishi & Bruno: The Flower Pot Oops!

shots.narration: Bruno's ball is heading straight for Mishi's flower pot!
shots.scene: Sunny garden patio beside a cosy colourful house; a flower pot stands near a soft ball, vertical 9:16, rounded 3D family animation, no text.
shots.action: Bruno sends the soft ball rolling toward the flower pot.
shots.mood: Warm sunlight, bright flowers, playful anticipation.

shots.narration: Oops! One little bump makes a big garden mess.
shots.scene: Garden patio with the ball beside a lightweight terracotta-coloured flower pot, vertical 9:16, soft rounded 3D forms, no text.
shots.action: The flower pot topples into two large smooth-edged pieces beside an intact flower root ball.
shots.mood: Gentle cartoon surprise, scattered soil, no sharp fragments.

shots.narration: [surprised] Bruno hadn't meant to break anything.
shots.scene: Sunny patio beside two rounded pot pieces and a flowering plant resting on its intact soil plug, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Bruno lowers his floppy ears toward the broken pot.
shots.mood: Soft golden light, drooping ears, regretful puppy eyes.

shots.narration: Mishi finds her favourite flower lying beside its pot.
shots.scene: Garden patio with the unharmed flowering plant and two large pot pieces between the friends, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi kneels beside the flowering plant.
shots.mood: Quiet concern, gentle green eyes, warm garden colours.

shots.narration: Bruno takes a brave breath and steps closer.
shots.scene: Patio beside the garden flower bed, Mishi seated near the broken planter, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Bruno takes one small step toward Mishi.
shots.mood: Tentative courage, soft sunlight, open space between friends.

shots.narration: [sighs] I'm sorry, Mishi. I'll help fix your pot.
shots.scene: Close view of the friends beside the broken flower pot, vertical 9:16, rounded 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Bruno places one paw gently over his chest.
shots.mood: Sincere puppy eyes, relaxed kitten expression, warm light.

shots.narration: Mishi brings strong tape for their little repair.
shots.scene: Low garden work mat beside the damaged pot, with an unmarked roll of wide colourful tape, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi slides the tape roll toward Bruno.
shots.mood: Hopeful faces, cheerful colours, cosy teamwork.

shots.narration: First, Mishi carefully fits the two pieces together.
shots.scene: Garden work mat with two large smooth-edged pot halves and the flower resting nearby, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi presses the matching pot halves together.
shots.mood: Careful little paws, focused green eyes, soft sunshine.

shots.narration: [chuckles] Bruno gives the pot a colourful tape belt.
shots.scene: Garden work mat with Mishi holding the fitted pot steady, wide plain colourful tape ready around its middle, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Bruno wraps a broad tape band around the repaired pot.
shots.mood: Proud puppy grin, bright tape, friendly rounded shapes.

shots.narration: Together, they give the flower its home again.
shots.scene: Sunny garden patio with the repaired taped pot upright between the friends, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi and Bruno lower the intact flower root ball into the repaired pot together.
shots.mood: Happy teamwork, upright blossoms, warm golden highlights.

shots.narration: The flower stands tall, and Mishi welcomes a hug.
shots.scene: Cosy garden patio beside the repaired flower pot, a curving trail of fallen petals visible beyond, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi and Bruno share a gentle hug.
shots.mood: Relieved smiles, bright blossoms, affectionate warmth.

shots.narration: [excited] Say sorry and help—next, let's follow those petals!
shots.scene: Sunny garden path with a winding trail of colourful petals leading behind a rounded shrub; repaired pot in the foreground, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Bruno points toward the winding petal trail.
shots.mood: Curious bright eyes, inviting sunshine, playful anticipation.

episode.endHook: Next, where does that mysterious garden trail lead?
episode.description: Bruno’s garden game ends with a broken flower pot and a droopy puppy face. With Mishi’s help, he learns that saying sorry and helping put things right belong together.
